name: Terms
description: Binds an enemy to a contract. While bound it deals 30% less damage and takes 20% more, because breaching costs it.

name: Leverage
description: Calls in a breach. Hits hardest on something already bound by Terms.

name: Accord
description: Terms that cover everyone. The party hits 15% harder for three turns and the gauge fills.

name: Good Faith
description: Talks an ally back onto their feet. Less than a healer would manage, but it costs one thread.

name: Settlement
description: Calls in every contract that is failing: each Bound enemy at half Resolve or less is settled off the field. A boss is never settled; its contract costs it a fifth of its Resolve instead.
